caption: The video captures a large dark grey whale resting at the surface of an open, slate-colored sea under a flat overcast sky. Its body stretches horizontally with the head, marked by a pale jaw patch, to the left and the tail to the right, while a dark, white-mottled pectoral fin rises vertically near the front of its body. In the upper right, two seabirds hang as small silhouettes against the grey. Throughout, the whale holds this floating pose, shifting only a little with the swell rather than swimming or sounding. The raised fin stays largely in the same upright attitude, and pale mottling across its body remains visible. The horizon shifts up and down across the view, while the animal remains at the surface. The two birds glide out of the upper sky within the first moments, leaving it bare. Midway, a white boat railing and a rounded fitting intrude at the bottom edge before vanishing again, while the whale continues to rest at the surface.
